mission: Mechanical re-derivation sweep over utilityexplained.com content: CONFIRM / REFUTE / UNVERIFIED per claim, per .squad/SQ-065/audit-prompt.md's credibility/freshness criteria. Four jobs: (1) FRESHNESS SWEEP across ALL 89 blog pages — grep for year references (2023/2024/2025/2026), stale statistics without current-year counterpoint (the metrics table flags staleY>0 on 11-understanding-kwh, 18-fuel-adjustment, 04-hidden-fees, 01-electric-bill, drought-surcharge, 45-generator(4), 48-heat-pump-vs-furnace(5), net-metering, how-to-lower-without-solar, electric-bill-breakdown, ductless-mini-split), unpublishable rot, and 'updated' frontmatter that doesn't match content reality; (2) SOURCE VERIFICATION — sample 12 numeric claims from the site's most source-heavy pages (EIA figures, average-bill numbers, payback periods on the money pages) and re-derive them against primary sources via web_search/web_fetch (cite URL + retrieved date); (3) METRICS TABLE AUDIT — spot-check 10 rows of .squad/content-metrics.md against the actual files (recount words/links/sources via wc/grep; flag discrepancies); (4) RENDERED-VS-SOURCE — web_fetch 5 live pages (01-how-to-read-your-electric-bill, do-home-energy-monitors-save-money, which-rate-plan-is-right-for-me, utilities-glossary, /) and compare: does the live HTML match the source markdown (no missing figures/boxes), are title/meta/description present and sane, is the sitemap at https://utilityexplained.com/sitemap.xml complete or broken. Write the full claim tables to .squad/SQ-065/wave1/verifier-claims.md.
parent_objective: SQ-065: Full-scale 9-section content/SEO/UX audit of utilityexplained.com (114 pages) per operator audit prompt — cloud-only formation
context: READ FIRST: .squad/SQ-065/audit-prompt.md (sections: Credibility and trust; Freshness and maintenance; Indexation and quality risks). constraints: READ-ONLY audit of site content: no writes under content/, layouts/, static/, assets/, data/, config — your ONLY write is .squad/SQ-065/wave1/verifier-claims.md
Every verdict carries evidence: quoted line + file path, or URL + retrieved date for web checks
Independent judgment: do not read other workers' outputs or prior audit reports (repo-root *AUDIT*/VISUAL*/AGENCY*/AMAZON* files)
success_criteria: .squad/SQ-065/wave1/verifier-claims.md exists with: freshness table (all staleY-flagged pages adjudicated), 12+ source-verification verdicts with URLs, 10-row metrics spot-check, 5-page rendered-vs-source comparison, production sitemap verdict
